nodes.label: $request.invokeTemplate external HTTP
nodes.rationale: Platform 3.0 requires external HTTP only via invokeTemplate and config/requests.json templates; direct $request.post|get|put|delete is forbidden.

nodes.label: Cold machine to ship lifecycle
nodes.rationale: fw-setup then fw-app-dev or fw-ai-actions-app, mandatory fw-review before submission, then fw-publish when publishing.

nodes.label: Agent Skills Specification layout
nodes.rationale: Each skill has SKILL.md, optional rules/commands/references/assets; editor rules live under skills/<name>/rules/ not nested .cursor/rules.

nodes.label: rulesDirectory in plugin.json
nodes.rationale: Cursor requires rulesDirectory and commandsDirectory in .cursor-plugin/plugin.json pointing to ./rules and ./commands or rules will not load.

nodes.label: Flat request parameters
nodes.rationale: Request parameters must stay flat with no nested objects; arrays of primitives allowed; arrays of objects forbidden; nested structures built in server.js.

nodes.label: Action feasibility Possible/Verify/Not available
nodes.rationale: Every scoped action must be classified against vendor docs before implementation handoff.

nodes.label: Manifest + Toolchain Gate
nodes.rationale: Must verify Node 24.x + FDK 10.x and Platform 3.0 before validation; never downgrade toolchain

nodes.label: Forbidden Platform 2.x Patterns
nodes.rationale: Zero tolerance for legacy platform-version, product block, whitelisted-domains, direct request methods

nodes.label: Freshdesk File Upload Unsupported
nodes.rationale: Object storage unavailable on Freshdesk; file upload via request template refs not supported

nodes.label: Intercept Events and Validation
nodes.rationale: Enforcement and blocking rules belong in intercept background apps; display and manual interaction belong in frontend UI.

nodes.label: OAuth integrations Wrapper (Platform 3.0)
nodes.rationale: Platform 3.0 breaking change: oauth_config.json must wrap providers in an integrations object, unlike Platform 2.x flat structure.

nodes.label: Serverless Sandbox and 20s Timeout
nodes.rationale: Serverless runs in sandbox without process/setTimeout APIs; execution capped at 20 seconds.

nodes.label: data.ticket Post-Update Snapshot
nodes.rationale: data.ticket is a post-update snapshot subset of API fields, not a guaranteed minimal diff of what changed

nodes.label: Delta Metadata Uncertainty (changes/model_changes)
nodes.rationale: Skill does not define stable contract that onTicketUpdate always includes changes or model_changes for support_ticket or service_ticket modules

nodes.label: Refusal: onTicketUpdate Delta Inference
nodes.rationale: Agents must not infer field-level changes from data.ticket alone when changes/model_changes is absent

nodes.label: Refusal: Premature FDK/Node Downgrade
nodes.rationale: Start with fdk 10.0.1 and node 24.11.0; downgrade only as LAST RESORT after six validate iterations
